sources.revision: Published 2021 MESH entity and 2024 entity-code guidance

observations.meshSchema: Group 92 declares level-0 vertex count, group 10 carries vertex positions, group 93 frames the face-list size, and groups 94/95 describe edge and crease counts.
observations.ordering: General DXF guidance says not to assume entity group-code order; entity-specific count and stream boundaries still define framing.

sources.limitation: DXF entity field documentation does not establish DWG byte layout, rendered geometry, or downstream 3D semantics.

localAudit.reproducedFailure: The prior parser required an X component to create the pending vertex; valid Y/Z-before-X coordinates were rejected before callback in both ASCII and Binary DXF.
localAudit.correction: Assign group 10/20/30 independently by per-axis occurrence ordinal into the declared vertex slots. Preserve same-code occurrence order and keep 92/93/94/95 phase framing and face/edge/crease parsing unchanged.
localAudit.privateStorage: Reuse the three existing private int32 parser-counter slots as per-axis occurrence counters in the vertex phase and as face/edge/crease counters afterward. Compile-time size/alignment assertions protect the storage contract; no public field, callback, or virtual was added.
generatedCoverage: Scratch-generated ASCII and Binary DXF; no persistent fixture
